en.editor.title: Title
en.editor.next_rain_enable_hint: MeteoSwiss Radar is installed but its nowcast is off — enable it in the integration’s options to show "Next rain".
en.editor.layout_board_hint: Drag rows between the columns to arrange them; arrow keys work too. Saved as attributes_layout.
en.editor.show_chart_sunshine_hint: Fetches sunshine duration directly from Open-Meteo (using Home Assistant's configured location, or the card's location). No additional sensors required. Daily mode shows "Xh" labels per column; hourly mode shows bars only (full bar = full hour of sun).
en.editor.show_chart_precip_probability_hin: Prints the chance of rain next to the amount in the precipitation label ("4.2 / 85" over "mm %"). Taken from the weather entity when its forecast provides it, otherwise from Open-Meteo (using Home Assistant’s configured location, or the card’s location). Dry days show the chance alone from 30 % up.
en.editor.sunshine_availability: Sunshine data available: {past} past days, {future} forecast days (Open-Meteo).
en.editor.sunshine_availability_pending: Sunshine: data still loading — save and reopen the editor.
en.editor.sunshine_availability_warning: Configured forecast_days ({req}) exceeds Open-Meteo availability — the last {gap} columns will show empty sunshine bars.
en.editor.openmeteo_history_hint: Fills the past half of the chart from Open-Meteo when no station sensors are configured. Sends your Home Assistant location, or the card's location, to Open-Meteo.
en.editor.openmeteo_history_unavailable: No past data: this card has no station sensors and Open-Meteo past data is off, so only the forecast can be shown. Turn on the option below, or add a station sensor, to enable the station and combination views.
en.editor.disable_animation_hint: Disables the 500 ms transition when the chart redraws. Weather icons and scrolling are not affected.
en.editor.number_of_forecasts_hint: How many bars are visible at once (default 8 — fits both 7-day daily and an hour-window at hourly). 0 = fit all without scrolling. When loaded bars exceed visible, scroll horizontally for the rest.
en.editor.past_source_openmeteo: From Open-Meteo — I have no weather station
en.editor.number_of_forecasts_helper: Visible columns: 0 = show all without scrolling
en.editor.time_format_hint: Applies to the clock and all times in the attributes row.
